information: [![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBa2xBIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--740c53d289def878faa5292856a4438109c059dc/image.png)](https://www.facebook.com/groups/pnwcubing) * [Visit our **webpage**](https://www.pnwcubing.com) * [See our **upcoming competitions**](https://www.pnwcubing.com/competitions) * [Join our **Facebook community**](https://www.facebook.com/groups/159856602085) * [Follow us on **Instagram**](https://www.instagram.com/pnwcubing/) * [Join our **Discord**](https://discord.gg/Z54vZUurHm) By registering for this competition, you should be aware of the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) and this specific competitions [Competitor Responsibilites](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/HillsboroNewcomers2025#54976-please-read-competitor-responsibilities). ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NjM0NDEsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--73cf99c84bee8f83fc3de86a81114e0cb3a0dc3c/Snip20241111_14.png) This competition is participating in the official WCA Newcomer Month 2025. The registration process will reserve 40% of spots for new competitors. New competitors are considered to have no WCA ID or a WCA ID with 2025. Returning competitors are considered to have a WCA ID that is from 2024 or earlier. All competitors must still follow all registration requirements for their registration to be considered complete. Registrations will be accepted based on the following: * 40% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are reserved for new competitors. * Initially, 40% of spots, as defined by the competitor limit, are available for returning competitors on a first come, first serve basis. * If greater than 40% of new competitors register before 40% of spots are filled by returning competitors, any additional new competitors will be accepted on a first come, first serve basis alongside returning competitors. * If the spots reserved for new competitors are not filled by new competitors before registration closes two weeks prior to the competition, remaining spots, up to the competitor limit, will be accepted from registered returning competitors. **Notice of filming and photography:** Attendees of PNW Cubing competitions consent to their images being used by PNW cubing and its partners in marketing materials, social media and other digital platforms.
